findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: text-to-structure, web-search, web-extract, search-brave, search-tavily, image-generate, email-verify, rh-stock-spreads, text-extract · Private data: text-to-structure, web-search, web-extract, web-answer, search-brave, search-tavily, image-generate, email-verify, wallet-lookup, wallet-lookup-pro, token-safety, rh-stock-spreads, rh-stock-spread-history, domain-lookup, dex-quote · Public sink: web-search, web-extract, search-brave, search-tavily, image-generate, email-verify, text-extract · Destructive: phone-lookup, hash-tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: text-to-structure, web-search, web-extract, search-brave, search-tavily, image-generate, email-verify, rh-stock-spreads, text-extract · Private data: text-to-structure, web-search, web-extract, web-answer, search-brave, search-tavily, image-generate, email-verify, wallet-lookup, wallet-lookup-pro, token-safety, rh-stock-spreads, rh-stock-spread-history, domain-lookup, dex-quote · Public sink: web-search, web-extract, search-brave, search-tavily, image-generate, email-verify, text-extract · Destructive: phone-lookup, hash-tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "fx-rates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Daily foreign-exchange reference rates for the major fiat currencies (USD, EUR, CNY, GBP, JPY, HKD and more) from the European Central Bank via Frankfurter: convert amounts, price in a local currency, or sanity-check a rate before a payment. Give a base currency and optional symbols and amount. Refe" → after: "Live foreign-exchange reference rates from the European Central Bank (ECB), updated every business day. Convert between 30+ currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY and more) with a single call: pass base and symbols, get mid-market reference rates as clean JSON. Rates are the ECB daily reference rates, "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
